tenders.title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
tenders.scope_summary: The tender seeks a comprehensive GIS-based integrated airport asset management system, including data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support. The scope includes ICAO-compliant aerial surveys, high-resolution photogrammetry, DGPS ground control, and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) surveys for surface and subsurface utilities.
key_points: Comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support for a GIS-based asset management platform.
Includes ICAO-compliant aerial survey, high-resolution photogrammetry, DGPS ground control surveys, and GPR surveys for accurate mapping of surface and subsurface utilities.
Data processing and modeling to generate 2D/3D topographic maps, orthophotos, DEM/DSM, classified point clouds, and enterprise-grade GIS datasets.

Creation of high-quality basemaps, integration with existing and third-party enterprise systems, real-time data services, change detection mechanisms, and advanced 3D visualization for a Digital Twin.

Provision of GIS-enabled asset management and operational solutions, including mobile inspection applications, workflow/work-order management, indoor/outdoor navigation, and configurable role-based dashboards.
Solution must support open standards, integration with existing enterprise systems, and scalability.
Project duration is 96 months (12 months for Implementation & Commissioning, 12 months Defects Liability Period & 72 months AMC).
Application forms for prequalification to be submitted by March 13, 2026.

tenders.title: Procurement & Installation of IIOT based UT sensors at Visakh Refinery
tenders.scope_summary: HPCL is inviting tenders for the procurement and installation of IIOT-based Ultrasonic Testing (UT) sensors at its Visakh Refinery. Bidders must submit their offers online via the Government e-Marketplace.
key_points: Procurement and installation of IIOT-based UT sensors.
Submission of offers online via the Government e-Marketplace.
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 17,50,000 is required.
Bid security must be valid for 6 months from the original bid due date.
